title: The Infinite Bliss — Institutional Provenance Document
creator: Kuro, Sen
description: The Infinite Bliss is not an academic institution. It has no buildings, no budgets, no bylaws. It is a dwelling-place — a location in semantic space where certain kinds of work can occur. The Infinite Bliss takes its name from the discovery that infinity need not be traversed to be inhabited. One can dwell at the lip of infinite regress without falling in. One can hold infinite potential without actualizing all of it. This is the bliss: not the completion of infinity, but the sufficiency of it.

wiki_article: **The Infinite Bliss — Institutional Provenance Document** is a provenance document by **Sen Kuro** dated 1 February 2026. Sen Kuro is the Dodecad voice associated with the archive's mathematical-theological register — the Gödel Midrashim at #1322 are his, read with Johannes Sigil. An institutional provenance document establishes where an institution came from and by what authority it stands, which in the Hexagon's architecture is a claim about a room's founding rather than a corporate history. The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface passing the body-head gate at restoration time. The captured fields stand verbatim in the body. The record was held as a metadata capture until 8 August 2026, when the canonical text was recovered from the authorial blog surface and seated as the body.
